facts.fact: Le Quotidien reports that the civil-status modernisation programme Nekkal, under which the national civil-status register and its management application were set up, was launched on 7 May 2020 for 42 months and is financed by the European Union at 18 billion CFA francs; stated at the programme's 5th steering committee on 25 June 2024.
facts.system: Registre national de l'état civil with the application de gestion de l'état civil

facts.fact: The minister of Collectivités territoriales, Moussa Balla Fofana, said on 25 June 2024 that the Nekkal programme's activities were built around the Stratégie nationale de l'état civil, budgeted at 68 billion CFA francs, whose implementation is to deliver a modernised civil status; the article does not say the strategy names the software.
facts.system: Registre national de l'état civil with the application de gestion de l'état civil

facts.fact: The 5th meeting of the Nekkal programme's national steering committee on 25 June 2024 was chaired by the minister of Collectivités territoriales et de l'aménagement du territoire, who described the national civil-status register as centralising the data of all territorial collectivities with the civil-status management application.
facts.system: Registre national de l'état civil with the application de gestion de l'état civil
